message.content: What study assistance is available for employees doing a formal degree or diploma?

message.content: Employees pursuing a formal degree or diploma relevant to their role may be eligible for study assistance covering up to 50% of tuition fees, capped at R30,000 per academic year. This assistance requires a 12-month retention agreement, and if the employee resigns within 12 months of receiving assistance, a pro-rated repayment applies. For more information or to apply, employees can contact Learning & Development at learning@apexsolutions.internal.
